lines.text: Lesson twenty-seven: reading XORA trading insights. The last lesson of Phase 6.
lines.say: Lesson twenty-seven: reading Zora trading insights. The last lesson of Phase six.

lines.text: In T26 you learned how XORA decides. Now let's read what it shows you.
lines.say: In T twenty-six you learned how Zora decides. Now let's read what it shows you.

lines.text: The Signals screen packs a lot onto one coin. We'll read it card by card, top to bottom.
lines.say: The Signals screen packs a lot onto one coin. We'll read it card by card, top to bottom.

lines.text: First, the TRADE OPPORTUNITY card. It shows the direction and the setup: here, BUY, support reclaim.
lines.say: First, the TRADE OPPORTUNITY card. It shows the direction and the setup: here, buy, support reclaim.

lines.text: ENTRY is where the trade would start. STOP is where it closes if price goes against you.
lines.say: ENTRY is where the trade would start. STOP is where it closes if price goes against you.

lines.text: RISK is the stop distance in percent. NEXT RES. is the next resistance above.
lines.say: RISK is the stop distance in percent. NEXT RES. Is the next resistance above.

lines.text: Under the numbers, a bar reads: 2.0 R to the next level. What is R?
lines.say: Under the numbers, a bar reads: two R to the next level. What is R?

lines.text: One R is your risk: the distance from entry to stop. Here, 60,000 minus 59,700 is 300.
lines.say: One R is your risk: the distance from entry to stop. Here, sixty thousand minus fifty-nine thousand seven hundred is three hundred.

lines.text: The next resistance is 600 away. 600 divided by 300 is 2. So, 2.0 R of room.
lines.say: The next resistance is six hundred away. Six hundred divided by three hundred is two. So, two R of room.

lines.text: It's room on the chart, not a promise.
lines.say: It's room on the chart, not a promise.

lines.text: Tap Full AI insights for the detailed page. It refreshes every 20 seconds.
lines.say: Tap Full AI insights for the detailed page. It refreshes every twenty seconds.

lines.text: At the top, the verdict: BUY if price trades above 60,000. For this candle only.
lines.say: At the top, the verdict: buy if price trades above sixty thousand. For this candle only.

lines.text: The PRICE MAP lines up resistance, support, your stop and entry, with distances in percent.
lines.say: The PRICE MAP lines up resistance, support, your stop and entry, with distances in percent.

lines.text: Further down: the ENTRY CHECKLIST, TRADE MANAGEMENT for open trades, and ENGINE STATUS.
lines.say: Further down: the ENTRY CHECKLIST, TRADE MANAGEMENT for open trades, and ENGINE STATUS.

lines.text: The TRADE PLAN does the maths. First, size: your margin times your leverage.
lines.say: The TRADE PLAN does the maths. First, size: your margin times your leverage.

lines.text: With 3 USDT margin at 10x, the position size is 3 times 10: 30 USDT.
lines.say: With three U-S-D-T margin at ten ex, the position size is three times ten: thirty U-S-D-T.

lines.text: The stop is 0.50% away. 0.50% of 30 USDT is 0.15 USDT.
lines.say: The stop is zero point five percent away. Zero point five percent of thirty U-S-D-T is zero point one five U-S-D-T.

lines.text: So if the stop is hit, you lose about 0.15 USDT, plus fees. Slippage can make it more.
lines.say: So if the stop is hit, you lose about zero point one five U-S-D-T, plus fees. Slippage can make it more.

lines.text: MARKET shows volatility as ATR, the average true range: how far a candle usually travels.
lines.say: MARKET shows volatility as ATR, the average true range: how far a candle usually travels.

lines.text: Here, ATR on 5 minutes is 90 USDT. Bigger ATR means wilder moves.
lines.say: Here, ATR on five minutes is ninety U-S-D-T. Bigger ATR means wilder moves.

lines.text: Recent swing highs and lows are the turning points price left behind.
lines.say: Recent swing highs and lows are the turning points price left behind.

lines.text: Next, swipe the market-read carousel. Card one: the Xora read, a plain summary.
lines.say: Next, swipe the market-read carousel. Card one: the Xora read, a plain summary.

lines.text: Its note says: computed on this phone, explanatory only. The engine's stop and exits do not use it.
lines.say: Its note says: computed on this phone, explanatory only. The engine's stop and exits do not use it.

lines.text: Card two: VOLUME COMPARISON. Buy volume against sell volume in this price range.
lines.say: Card two: VOLUME COMPARISON. Buy volume against sell volume in this price range.

lines.text: Card three: ORDER BOOK DIFFERENCE. Big resting orders, called walls, on each side, and the spread.
lines.say: Card three: ORDER BOOK DIFFERENCE. Big resting orders, called walls, on each side, and the spread.

lines.text: Spoof risk: walls that appear and vanish may be fake.
lines.say: Spoof risk: walls that appear and vanish may be fake.

lines.text: Absorption: big orders soak up trades, and price barely moves.
lines.say: Absorption: big orders soak up trades, and price barely moves.

lines.text: Card four: PRICE-RANGE REPLAY. When price was here before, compared with now.
lines.say: Card four: PRICE-RANGE REPLAY. When price was here before, compared with now.

lines.text: Card five: TRIGGER LEVELS. For example, the stop: where the trade closes.
lines.say: Card five: TRIGGER LEVELS. For example, the stop: where the trade closes.

lines.text: How far ahead does XORA look? Decisions are made per 1-minute candle.
lines.say: How far ahead does Zora look? Decisions are made per one-minute candle.

lines.text: Each plan lasts one candle. When it closes, the checks run again on fresh data.
lines.say: Each plan lasts one candle. When it closes, the checks run again on fresh data.

lines.text: The 5m, 15m and 1h charts add context. XORA does not predict price 10 or 15 minutes ahead.
lines.say: The five-minute, fifteen-minute and one-hour charts add context. Zora does not predict price ten or fifteen minutes ahead.

lines.text: A common mistake: treating insights as a forecast. 2.0 R is room, not a promise.
lines.say: A common mistake: treating insights as a forecast. Two R is room, not a promise.

lines.text: And the Xora read only explains the market now. It does not predict it.
lines.say: And the Xora read only explains the market now. It does not predict it.

lines.text: Use insights to understand a setup, then decide calmly.
lines.say: Use insights to understand a setup, then decide calmly.

lines.text: Your turn. Margin 3 USDT at 10x. Entry 60,000, stop 59,400. How much is at risk?
lines.say: Your turn. Margin three U-S-D-T at ten ex. Entry sixty thousand, stop fifty-nine thousand four hundred. How much is at risk?

lines.text: Size is 3 times 10: 30 USDT. The stop is 600 away: 1.00%. 1.00% of 30 is 0.30 USDT.
lines.say: Size is three times ten: thirty U-S-D-T. The stop is six hundred away: one percent. One percent of thirty is zero point three U-S-D-T.

lines.text: That's 0.30 USDT before fees and slippage. Well done if you got it!
lines.say: That's zero point three U-S-D-T before fees and slippage. Well done if you got it!

lines.text: Insights help, but they don't remove risk.
lines.say: Insights help, but they don't remove risk.

lines.text: XORA does not guarantee profits. Setups fail, and losing trades happen.
lines.say: Zora does not guarantee profits. Setups fail, and losing trades happen.

lines.text: Fees, slippage and leverage can make a loss bigger than the plan shows.
lines.say: Fees, slippage and leverage can make a loss bigger than the plan shows.

lines.text: Practise in DEMO first. This is education, not financial advice.
lines.say: Practise in demo first. This is education, not financial advice.

lines.text: Recap. The TRADE OPPORTUNITY card: entry, stop, risk, next level, and R.
lines.say: Recap. The TRADE OPPORTUNITY card: entry, stop, risk, next level, and R.

lines.text: Size is margin times leverage. Risk is size times the stop distance.
lines.say: Size is margin times leverage. Risk is size times the stop distance.

lines.text: Insights explain the market now. They are not predictions.
lines.say: Insights explain the market now. They are not predictions.

lines.text: Congratulations! You've finished Phase 6, and the whole Futures Edge course.
lines.say: Congratulations! You've finished Phase six, and the whole Futures Edge course.

lines.text: Now practise in DEMO. XORA does not guarantee profits. Not financial advice.
lines.say: Now practise in demo. Zora does not guarantee profits. Not financial advice.
